descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# WHAT IS THIS GAME?

**Block'em Up** is a short spatial puzzle game built on a wordplay of *"Blocking"*:
* **Cinema:** Planning actors' movement on set.
* **Psychology:** Suppressing emotions to survive the day.
* **Gameplay:** Blending Beat'em Up action with AR blocks in your room to guide Kira—a sarcastic stunt actress—through low-budget chaos.

*It’s a short game, and doesn't pretend to be anything else. My brain hurts...*

---

# A LETTER TO A (HOPEFULLY) FUTURE PLAYER

Hi there!

I’m a solo developer making this game—a bit of a "Europoor" guy from Santiago de Compostela (Spain).

Once Meta takes their cut, buying this game costs about the price of a cool coffee here in Santiago. Every cent goes back into development: first to add content here, and then for my next project (about a cat, so probably better).

**VOICE ACTING HEADS-UP:**

Current voices are AI (sorry!). My own voice is too masculine for Kira, but if I earn enough money, there’s a local theatre school where I can hire soon-to-be actors for awesome studio voices.

**WHAT'S NEXT?**

It's brief. I'm trying to release more levels, but budget is tight, so selling a few copies helps a lot! More levels will come if I have the money. Right now, I'm working on new features and an *Extended Footage* mini-DLC.

You can check I’m real on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/gonzaloiv/) or Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/iamgonzaloiv/). 

Thanks for supporting independent XR!

— **Gonzalo**
